mentions.name: FinditAgent
mentions.description: FinditAgent is a Windows tool that lets AI agents research large collections of local files without a vector database, acting like grep on steroids across almost any file format while giving the AI no direct access to the local file system. The user asks a question, the AI creates the search strategy and queries, and FinditAgent performs the searches and sends back only results or UTF-8 excerpts. It offers predefined connections to the APIs of most cloud models as well as to local AI via Ollama. It is a one-click Windows install, free for private and experimental use, available on GitHub, and the underlying search engine has been developed for over 30 years.
mentions.problem: Enables AI agents to search large local file collections without a vector database and without exposing the local file system directly to the AI.
